timeline.event: Officers arrive; Rowan pronounced dead on scene
Alvarez identifies shooter as 'man in red hoodie'
Park identifies shooter as 'wearing black jacket'
Informant Hines gives statement implicating Marlow

evidence_map.description: Hines cooperation agreement — undisclosed pending charges dropped

findings.title: Eyewitness clothing descriptions conflict
findings.description: Alvarez: red hoodie. Park: black jacket. Same incident, ~30 min apart.
findings.source_quote: he was wearing a red hoodie, pulled up

findings.title: Park's clothing statement contradicts Alvarez
findings.source_quote: definitely a black jacket, zipped up

findings.title: Informant received undisclosed benefit
findings.description: Hines had two pending felony charges dropped after cooperating; not disclosed in initial discovery.
findings.source_quote: in exchange for truthful testimony, State agrees to dismiss cases 25-CR-441 and 25-CR-502

findings.title: Ballistics chain of custody gap
findings.description: No custody entry between 3/17 lab transfer and 3/22 return.
findings.source_quote: Received: 3/15. Returned to locker: 3/22. (no intervening entries)

findings.title: Warrantless search of vehicle
findings.description: Officer search of Marlow's vehicle occurred before warrant issued.
findings.source_quote: vehicle searched at 23:10; search warrant timestamp 23:47

findings.title: Missing camera 3 footage
